definitions.explanation: The state of great comfort and expensive living beyond what is necessary.

examples.japanese: {贅沢|ぜいたく}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しんだ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{贅沢|ぜいたく}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{悩|なや}み→悩み：06650_nayami⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: That's a luxury problem / That's a nice problem to have.
examples.notes: Common expression for when someone has a minor complaint about a fortunate situation

examples.english: Why don't you treat yourself a little?

examples.english: When I was a child, a luxurious lifestyle was out of the question.

examples.english: Just being healthy is enough — wanting more than that is asking too much.

notes:
{贅沢|ぜいたく} can be used as a noun or な-adjective.

FORMS:
- {贅沢|ぜいたく}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧ + noun (luxurious ~)
- {贅沢|ぜいたく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to live extravagantly, to splurge)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {贅沢|ぜいたく}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{悩|なや}み→悩み：06650_nayami⟧ (a luxury problem, first-world problem)
- {贅沢|ぜいたく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ (to be demanding/picky)
- {贅沢|ぜいたく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{敵|てき}→敵：03546_teki⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧ (Luxury is the enemy - wartime slogan)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {贅沢|ぜいたく}⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧ (luxury goods)
- {贅沢|ぜいたく}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{暮|く}らし→暮らし：02670_kurashi⟧ (luxurious lifestyle)
